basic_info.description: Steps to Sanchez's Slow Street and 24th St shops, cafes and restaurants, w a 95 WalkScore, this modern 2BR flat has it all! Enter this pristine mid-century building into a light filled, open floor plan. Living, dining and kitchen spaces flow together surrounded by windows. Professional remodeled kitchen with freshly painted cabinets, stainless appliances, quartz countertops, ceramic tile backsplash, a breakfast bar, and plenty of work and storage space. The window-lined dining space is perfect for dinner parties and family gatherings. The spacious living room is bathed in natural light. There are two generous BDRs and a full tiled bath. Expansive, verdant shared backyard with deck and lawn spaces surrounded by mature plantings. Exclusive use washer & dryer in the garage. This meticulously maintained building was fully renovated in 2006 with new windows and structural upgrades. Newly refinished warm wood floors. Fresh interior paint. New roof (2024). Deeded side by side garage parking. Steps to Chloe's Cafe, Saru Sushi, tech shuttles, the J, BART, and other major MUNI lines. Minutes to 280/101 freeways and SFO. Stroll the Saturday farmers market, grab groceries at Whole Foods, and exercise while communing with neighbors on Sanchez's Slow Street. The whole package!
